messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime-streaming.p95 exceeded 1.2s in us-west-2 for last 5m. Paging on-call @ben.oncall. Incident: INC-2026-7721. Grafana: https://ops.redwood.ai/d/streaming/realtime

ben.oncall: I'm on call, joining. Any reports from customers?

dora-support: just got two tickets: acct: eduwise and acct: paygrid — both report SSE clients hanging and reconnect loops around 2026-03-17T22:18Z. CS tickets CS-7899 and CS-7900 opened.

carla-sre: seeing proxy write stalls in traces for streaming-proxy-eu-*, sudden rise in blocked syscalls on write() with long queue depth. p95 ~1.6s, p99 ~7.2s.

nina-telemetry: snapshot 22:10-22:20 UTC:
``
stream.p95: 1600ms (norm ~240ms)
stream.p99: 7200ms (norm ~950ms)
stream_error_rate: 1.8% (norm 0.12%)
proxy_5xx: +520 in 10m
``

luis-plat: FYI we deployed proxy tuning at 21:45 that touched tcp_wmem and client_backpressure parameters. Might have reduced headroom for long-lived SSE flows.

alice.ops: starting mitigation: will revert proxy tuning and disable client_backpressure flag on the proxy pool; doing canary restart 2 nodes first. ETA ~3m. Increasing proxy write timeout to 90s temporarily.

ben.oncall: assign: alice -> mitigation rollback + monitoring, carla -> collect flamegraphs and trace IDs, dora -> CS notifications and impact table. I'll coordinate and update page.

carla-sre: collecting traces now. Early evidence: kernel tx buffer saturation causing proxy write to block; downstream clients send small window updates causing retransmit bursts. Some clients trigger library reconnects which worsen chunk gaps.

alice.ops: canary rollback finished (2/2 canary nodes), no regressions so rolling remainder (6 nodes total). Turning off client pacing; adding routing rule to shift 10% of streams to dedicated low-churn pool as safety.

nina-telemetry: new metrics (22:20-22:26 UTC):
``
stream.p95: 300ms
stream.p99: 680ms
stream_error_rate: 0.18%
proxy_5xx: back to baseline
``

dora-support: CS updated both customers: issue mitigated, asking for any lingering reconnects. Escalated to account managers for follow-up.

ben.oncall: Good. Keep monitoring for 20m. If stable we'll clear page and open RCA. Carla, include root cause hypothesis + reproducer steps. Alice, document rollback runbook and add CI preflight for proxy kernel param changes.

carla-sre: Will attach representative trace IDs and a short repro script using many long-lived SSE clients with randomized window sizes. Hypothesis: combined effect of reduced kernel tx buffer headroom + proxy-level client_backpressure caused write stalls under high churn.

alice.ops: leaving runbook notes: rollback command, toggle for client_backpressure flag, routing to dedicated pool steps, and emergency monitor playbook. Propose a canary gating step before any future proxy tuning.

ben.oncall: marking as mitigated and standing down paging after 20m stable window. Creating INC-2026-7721-RCA and handing to eng-sre. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
